verdict.rationale: Highnote issues virtual cards via API, and its spend rules can act on authorization count, dollar amount and MCC. It also offers per-transaction caps, real-time collaborative authorization, and cards that close automatically when a workflow ends, so a one-purchase, exact-amount card can be assembled from these parts. However, there is no documented single-use card type, and merchant scoping is shown only at the MCC (category) level, not for one specific merchant. Missing for 10: an explicit single-use/burner card feature, a documented lock to a specific merchant ID (beyond MCC or custom collaborative-auth logic), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
